manifest.activation: Bundled, code-pinned schema/provider API/input schema and artifact hashes. No runtime download or remote activation.

changes: Verify bundled pose model and posture reference before native camera start. Use content-addressed cache and verify existing bytes; refuse corrupt cache, preserve legacy file. Atomic write of bundled bytes only. Different release hashes allow safe app-release rollback.
Verify guitar observation config against the same activation root. Unsupported instruments and closed posture scoring cannot be enabled by manifest flags alone.

Reject duplicate/reversed/negative audio timestamps and unknown clock domains. Clear old samples and calibration on a gap or sample-rate change; pending analysis is settled without accepting stale results.
Show feedback availability in instrument routes and all four directly reachable starter courses; preserve written lesson access and self-recorded progress.

groups.notes: Later final model/audio run replaces affected cases; not added again.

softwareVerification.countMethod: 90 + 1 new legacy cache case + (29 - 12 overlapping feedback cases) + 78 = 186; reruns are replacements, not additional acceptance.

bounds.timestampToleranceMeaning: Software continuity buffer guard for estimated Android read timestamps, not AV synchronization or a measured physical acceptance tolerance.
bounds.newTestFixtures: Only test/*.dart; synthetic byte arrays, fake channels and timestamped PCM. No physical inference or teaching result.

bounds.storeUpload: Not authorized; first three groups and final user release decision remain open.

futureModelUpdate: Freeze task definitions, independent data labels and validation thresholds before holdout; use the existing Core intake/split/test-open tooling.
Select and implement the real provider and schema; bind exact model/config/calibration hashes and scoped tasks. Update bundled manifest and code pin together in a new app release.
Keep unsupported/calibrationRequired/unobservable states when input or evidence is missing. No automatic lesson mastery or finger pressure/physical-contact claim.
Run isolated software rejection/lifecycle tests, then source-bound physical audio/camera/device and independent expert/data acceptance. Only those results can change the real capability gate.

sharedProviderContractReview.migration: Optional shared contract read-only reviewed. App activation verifies actual bytes; it does not assert validated accuracy. A planned future pin adoption must map unsupported/releaseClosed conservatively and require independent reviewed acceptance.
